probe_gatt.name: Probe GATT (development only)
probe_gatt.description: Development-only. Wait for a live advertisement from the privately supplied Bluetooth address, then list GATT metadata without characteristic I/O.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Development-only. Copy the Bluetooth address for FORA 6 CONNECT from Settings → Connectivity → Bluetooth → Advertisement Monitor. It is used only in memory for this probe and is not returned or persisted. Do not share it publicly.
